name: double_slit
doc:
THE DOUBLE-SLIT EXPERIMENT (Matt, 2026-10-13: "look at the original double slit experiment"). Its own
rooted stick, the parallel to the chirality stick. SEAL the three faces through the live verifiers: the
WAVE signature (fringe spacing Dy = lambda L / d, optics.double_slit), the MEASUREMENT law (the Born rule
P_i = |a_i|^2 / Sum|a_j|^2, quantum_computing.born_rule - probability is amplitude squared), and the
DUALITY (matter is wave too, lambda = h/p, optics.de_broglie - a single electron fired one at a time still
builds the fringes). One source, many potential paths, one outcome observed. What HAPPENS at the
measurement stays the open question (the interpretations are charted on the measurement stick). Idempotent;
new stick. Cite Young (1804), Joensson (1961), Tonomura (1989).

sticks.question: The double-slit experiment
sticks.statement: Light (and matter) through two slits makes an interference pattern - the wave signature; yet it arrives in discrete hits whose probabilities are the squared amplitudes - the Born rule; and a single electron fired one at a time still builds the fringes - wave-particle duality. One source, many potential paths, one outcome observed.
references: T. Young, Experiments and calculations relative to physical optics, Bakerian Lecture (1804)
C. Joensson, Elektroneninterferenzen an mehreren kuenstlich hergestellten Feinspalten, Z. Phys. 161 (1961) 454
A. Tonomura et al., Demonstration of single-electron buildup of an interference pattern, Am. J. Phys. 57 (1989) 117

marks.claim: [the wave signature] Two slits lit by one source make bright and dark fringes spaced Dy = lambda L / d; for lambda = 500 nm, d = 0.1 mm, L = 1 m, Dy = 5 mm (sealed through optics.double_slit). Interference - the mark of a wave.

[the measured outcome - the Born rule] Each arrival is a discrete hit; the probability of an outcome is its squared amplitude, P(i) = |a_i|^2 / Sum|a_j|^2. For (a,b) = (0.6, 0.8), P(1) = 0.64 (sealed through quantum_computing.born_rule). Probability is amplitude squared.

[wave-particle duality] Matter interferes too: an electron has wavelength lambda = h/p. For an electron at 1e6 m/s, lambda = 7.27e-10 m (sealed through optics.de_broglie) - and fired one at a time, single electrons still build the pattern. The particle goes through as a wave of possibility.

[the ground] The arithmetic is sealed: the fringe spacing, the squared-amplitude probabilities, the matter wavelength. That each particle's path is INDETERMINATE until measured - a superposition of both slits - is the reading the evidence forces; it is inferred, carried, not kept as fact. The capstone pattern: one source, many potentials, one end.

[declined] WHAT happens at the measurement - collapse, branching, pilot wave - is not sealed here; the interpretations are an empirically-equivalent Babel, charted on stick_the_schrodinger_equation. The engine seals the predictions, not the metaphysics.
